name: Tempester 1.6.0.0 — remote panel
summary: The whole front panel can be played from a computer over MIDI.

additions: Every panel key can be pressed and released over MIDI (the Debug menu stays out of reach).
The state of the panel LEDs is sent back as it changes, and on request.
The 14 encoders and 10 absolute controls can be turned over MIDI.

description: 1.5.6.0 plus n°21: remote panel keys (CC 102 press / CC 103 release on Remote Pad IN, Debug menu refused), n°22: LED states sent over MIDI (CC 104 on / CC 105 off on Remote Pad OUT, CC 107 = full state request) and n°23: remote encoders and controls (NRPN 200-213 steps, 220-229 absolute). Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
